learning_objective: 🎯 Today we will learn about the important places around our homes and how to find our way using directions and maps!

main_concepts.simple_explanation: Our neighbourhood has many useful places like hospitals, post offices, markets, and police stations. These places help us get the things we need easily and keep us safe.
To go from one place to another, we use directions! The four main directions are North, South, East, and West. The sun always rises in the East and sets in the West.
A map is like a drawing of a place from high up in the sky! We use landmarks, which are special or big buildings, to help us find an exact address without getting lost.

fun_activity.title: 🎨 Be a Map Maker!
fun_activity.instructions: Take a piece of paper and draw a simple map of your street. Don't forget to mark your house with a star and draw one important landmark near it!

quick_recap: ⭐ A neighbourhood includes all the houses, shops, and places near our home.
⭐ North, South, East, and West help us figure out which way to go.
⭐ Maps and landmarks are super tools that help us find our way without getting lost.
